rows.en: Everyone! Listen to my heart!
You're gonna get a full dose of my song!
Hold it!
Heh, I'll make this place blaze!
Time to go big! Fire!
Fighting is stupid! Listen to my song!
I'll make it echo across the whole universe!
Stop fighting! Don't fight!
Don't shoot! Missiles are stupid!
Still alive, huh! Then I've got plenty more for you!
Damn it! I lost another member of my audience!
I'm not singing for this!
My songs aren't a tool for killing people!
Here they come.
Came to listen, huh? I'll blow you away!
All right, time to belt one out!
rows.notes: Ambiguous 'ippatsu iku' (one shot): read as a song.

rows.en: Whoa! You made me shoot!
Nothing comes from shooting at each other.
Stop killing each other! Listen to my song!
If it comes to that, I'll just dodge!
My shield's busted.
Tch!
Fighting is stupid!
You won't listen to my song?!
Come on, you're relentless!
Quit making a racket!
I'm not going down! The show's just getting started!
Shut up already.
This won't stop my song!
Listen properly!
Don't get in my way!
Listen to my song, seriously!
Gonna have to get it fixed again.
Remember this. Next time I'll make you feel it.
Ugh, ow. What a disaster, damn it.
Why won't you listen to my song?!
rows.notes: Transcript 'kiki agaranee' is odd; read as 'kiite kurenee'.

rows.en: You okay?
Like hell you're fine!
Geez, every last one of you is trouble!
Huh? What did you say?
Oh, man.
Dammit all!
More fans in the crowd! Now I'm fired up!
Finally wanna hear my song? Fine, I'll give you the full show!
First things first, you lot, listen to my song!
You bastard!
rows.notes: Transcript 'ierou' (yellow); probably 'yarou' (bastard). Other pilots' clip 151 is an angry reaction to being hit.

rows.en: Stop it!
You've gotta be kidding me!
Heh, you all got way too into it!
Someday you'll get my sound too, I promise.
What, has everybody gone already?
Wait! The live show isn't over! Listen up!
I haven't sung enough! Not like this.
Hey, you! Stay and listen to the end!
Sigh, this sucks. Nobody listens to my song.
What am I lacking?
No, this isn't it.
Stop! Don't shoot!
Don't shoot! Don't you dare shoot!
Pierce their heart!
Beating them down with force is pointless!
Force isn't the answer!
Get in closer and let them hear your song!
Don't you dare lay a finger on them!
You just charge in there!
Sit there quietly and listen to my song!
Hurling your burning heart out, that's a song.
Slam your heart into it with everything you've got! Fire!
Give it everything! Go all out, full blast!
I'm heating up!
Here we go!
Yeah! Time to burn!
Geez, you're noisy.
Geez, you're such a slave driver.
Geez, of course I can do it.
You just don't get it, Captain.
You're ruining my song! Don't charge in!
rows.notes: Transcript 'tsukkonda na' (charged in); read as 'tsukkomu na'.

rows.en: Geez, quit fighting and listen to my song!
I told you shooting at each other doesn't work!
Hey! Don't die! I've still got songs I want you to hear!
